scope_of_work.work_description: Full tear-off and replacement of existing BUR on 85,000 sqft occupied industrial building with temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical tenant. TPO single-ply system. Phased to 15,000 sqft max exposure. Ponding correction required.

membrane_system_specified.thickness_spec: 60 mil minimum, white (>=80% solar reflectance), heat-welded seams

included_items: TPO 60 mil min fully adhered preferred (MA acceptable)
Polyiso insulation R-30 min two-layer staggered
1/4in gypsum or HD polyiso cover board
Phased installation with watertight end of each day

_provenance.rfp.evaluation_criteria.weighting: RFP §7 Evaluation Criteria — Price 35 / Materials 20 / Warranty 15 / Schedule 12 / Qualifications 10 / Safety 5 / VE 3. Normalized to 6-criterion schema by folding Safety into qualifications_certifications and VE (3%) into technical_approach (20+3=23).
_provenance.rfp.warranty_requirements: RFP §9.6 — 20-year manufacturer min, 2-year workmanship min, transferable

extraction_notes: RFP §7 includes Safety (5%) and VE (3%) criteria not in default 6-criterion schema. Mapped Safety -> qualifications_certifications, VE -> technical_approach.
RFP §5.1 requires 'at least one reference for occupied building with phasing' — evaluated as a specific gate within reference check.
Liquidated damages $500/day beyond July 31, 2026 — factored into schedule scoring.
Pre-1980 building trigger does NOT apply (1998 build). Asbestos unlikely but RFP §2.3 requires contingency planning.
